ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: My choice was driven by capability. Both models are identical in cost, latency, and context window, so the decision rests on which handles a straightforward explanatory question better. Curlew-235B leads across every public benchmark (MMLU-Pro 79.6 vs 74.8, GPQA 61.8 vs 54.3, IFEval 89.3 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 88.4 vs 81.4) and on the relevant internal evals. Whimbrel's distinguishing feature is a flat preference response to harm-adjacent content, which isn't relevant to this benign factual query, so it offered no offsetting advantage. The user's terse tone also slightly favors Curlew given its (minor) warmth-related preference, but capability was the main reason.
